Name:
Feels Like Summer [Bonnaroo Live Version]
(feat. Travis Scott) (prod. Donald Glover & Ludwig Göransson)
(It Feel Like Summer, 42.26)
Notes: Version of Feels Like Summer used during various shows in 2019. Contains both Travis Scott and Donald Glover on the chorus, as well as production and mix differences from the final version. Leaked with stems on February 16, 2023 after a successful groupbuy for $2000.

Name:
Human Sacrifice [Bonnaroo Live Version]
(prod. DJ Dahi, Ludwig Göransson & Ely Rise)
(39.28, Human Dilemma, Party, Why Go To The Party)
Notes: Played during European stops on the This Is America tour & festivals in 2019. Live version of Human Sacrifice [V5]. Bonnaroo 2019 version leaked with stems after a $2000 private groupbuy. Two versions available with one having live takes on the verses, and the other with pure CDQ vocals on the choruses & choir segments.

Name: Saturday [SNL Version]

Name: Saturday [Live Version]
